name: Instant Crush Lead
description: Inspired-by approximation for the ~3:18 lead/electric-guitar material -- NOT a claim of reproducing Daft Punk's actual guitar tone/rig (spec section 43/44). Aims for melodic, polished, expressive -- not metal-distorted. Chain: pluck source -> compression -> mild saturation -> chorus -> stereo delay -> reverb; the F75 knob's expression macro sweeps brightness/drive/delay together.
